headline: Completed the full arc: exact irreversible trade consent, player-authored Architect objectives, monotonic session truth, and one deployable release authority proven on stable staging with current visual, performance and edge receipts.

items.title: Irreversible choice clarity
items.evidence: Live on-clock trade acceptance now pauses at an accessible exact-pick review; only explicit confirmation mutates the draft.

items.title: Player-authored Architect hierarchy
items.evidence: Planning-friction receipts persist from real decisions and Architecture Review joins identity, active pressure, next proof and mastery path without predicted outcomes or hidden buffs.

items.title: Monotonic session authority
items.evidence: Startup resolution chooses the newest committed status/handoff/SIL session and cannot self-heal backward.

items.title: Exact release and performance lineage
items.evidence: Candidate 046e35df… / artifact 656eb904… is exact across staging, 64 inspected captures and passing desktop/mobile public-entry metrics; receipt-only descendants are Git-proven and deployable deltas fail closed.

followUps.title: Observe real cohorts
followUps.evidence: Measure consenting first-session and Community Stats behavior without manufacturing activity.

followUps.title: Retain game-shell diagnostic
followUps.evidence: The direct /game.html first-run tutorial layout-shift red remains a future optimization input, separate from the passing canonical public-entry gate.

blockers.title: Public launch remains HOLD
blockers.evidence: Zoho delivery/reply-as, SHA-bound founder approval and authoritative lifecycle reconciliation remain unproved; deployment does not clear them.

honestyLedger.title: No fabricated aggregate
honestyLedger.evidence: One long aggregate had a transient Studio red; unchanged-source Studio passed 196/196 alone and all 1,069 shard tests are green, while clean CI remains aggregate authority.

honestyLedger.title: No diagnostic laundering
honestyLedger.evidence: The public entry performance gate passes, while the direct game-shell first-run layout shift is retained in a separate red diagnostic.

honestyLedger.title: No launch overclaim
honestyLedger.evidence: Stable-staging and eventual production deployment are recorded independently from launchReady, which remains false.
